preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the code n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= n for n, x, y in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, x and y satisfy 0 ≤ x ≤ y ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n + 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2] for b_i in map(int, line.split()))
preconditions.description: Each color in Bob's guess is between 1 and n+1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' followed by a valid secret code a if one exists, or 'NO' if no valid code exists.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n + 1 for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip() != 'NO'])
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, each color in the secret code a is between 1 and n+1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip() != 'NO'])
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the secret code a has length n.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a_i == b_i for a_i, b_i in zip(a, b)) == x for a, b, x, y in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip() != 'NO'], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]], [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the number of indices where a_i equals b_i is exactly x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(a) & set(b)) == y for a, b, x, y in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip() != 'NO'], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]], [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]]))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the size of the intersection of a and b as multisets is exactly y.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(min(cnt_a[c], cnt_b[c]) for c in cnt_a) == y for a, b, x, y in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip() != 'NO'], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]], [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[::2]]) if (cnt_a := {c: a.count(c) for c in set(a)}) and (cnt_b := {c: b.count(c) for c in set(b)}))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the multiset intersection size of a and b is exactly y.
